**Yes. The full uniform compiler exists.** A private-prefix elementary lift, together with a quantitative averaging lemma for complete marked paths, gives the requested construction.

One explicit, deliberately generous choice of uniform resource constants is
\[

p_D=5D+25,\qquad
A_D=2^{100(D+1)^3}.
}
\tag{1}
\]

The essential additional result is a **path-space averaging bound that preserves exact event times**. It handles the initial assembly period, the hidden state after every observed event, original null and parallel labels, and the terminal part of the observation interval. I prove that bound below and then give explicit rational compiler outputs.

\[
c=A_{i_1}+\cdots+A_{i_q},\qquad q=|c|_1.
\]

When \(q\ge2\), introduce private species
\[
P_{c,2},\ldots,P_{c,q}
\]
and hidden reversible channels
\[
A_{i_1}+A_{i_2}\rightleftarrows P_{c,2},

\tag{3}
\]

A uniform elementary compiler for complete stochastic kinetics

FULL QUESTION. Can arbitrary conservative reaction networks of bounded molecularity be compiled into autonomous elementary networks that preserve the COMPLETE timed labelled trajectory law, with polynomial physical and binary costs UNIFORM in the input network, under arbitrary predictable rate faults?

For EVERY fixed integer D>=3, require one total deterministic compiler and explicitly computable constants A_D>=1,p_D>=1 depending ONLY on D. Its variable binary input consists of:
 * ANY finite labelled reaction list R={(y_r,z_r)} on d species with |y_r|_1,|z_r|_1<=D, including null/parallel labels;
 * positive INTEGER conservation weights omega with omega.(z_r-y_r)=0 for every label;
 * arbitrary rational0<k_r<=1, initial x0 in N^d, rational reference horizon tau>0 and rational0<epsilon<1/8.
No weak reversibility, complex balance, equilibrium distribution, gap or special reaction graph is assumed. On UNIT volume let X be the original mass-action chain with labelled intensity k_r(X)_(y_r). Falling factorials, including (X)_0=1, fix the convention. Conservation makes its reachable state space finite without truncation; the state space is not given or enumerated.

The emitted finite species/channel structure B_R and fixed nonnegative integer linear decoder P depend ONLY on R. P is identity on original species, and EVERY decoder column is nonzero. Canonical initialization is j(x)=(x,0), with no hidden initial fuel or sampled auxiliary equilibrium. Every fine channel has at most TWO molecules on EACH side. Supply a fixed map ell from fine labels to original labels or the hidden symbol empty.

Preserve the ACTUAL directed graph from EVERY fine state u: a hidden firing has decoded change zero; a firing mapped to r realizes the enabled original edge P u->P u-y_r+z_r, so P u>=y_r. Conversely, every enabled original labelled edge has a finite fine path between its canonical encodings. Require exact projection of every actual communicating class to the original communicating class; preserve directed reachability as well, not merely a lattice or undirected component. Every fine channel conserves omega.Pu. These conditions bound the ENTIRE physical fine population by B=max(1,omega.x0), even under faults.
